meta.name: A to Z
meta.description:
The story follows the lives of Andrew, an employee at an internet dating site who dreams of meeting the girl of his dreams, and Zelda, a no-nonsense lawyer who was raised by a hippie mother and carries a rebellious streak. By an accidental chance of fate, Zelda meets Andrew to resolve a mismatch dating dispute and these two single people suddenly find themselves falling for each other.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 2 Oct 2014 · United States of America · Language: English · 22 min
Studio: Warner Bros. Television, Le Train Train · Network: NBC

Complete series. On your server: S1 13/13

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: A Is for Acquaintances
videos.overview: A computer glitch sends Zelda to the office of an internet dating agency, where she meets Andrew and immediately sparks fly. Is it chance or destiny?

videos.title: B Is for Big Glory
videos.overview: After a great night together both Andrew and Zelda try to play it cool by going on a date with someone else.

videos.title: C Is for Curiouser & Curiouser
videos.overview: Andrew and Zelda discover that sometimes the internet can be a curse, when they both discover things about eachother that they wish they hadn't.

videos.title: D Is for Debbie
videos.overview: When Zelda's aunt dies, she isn't sure if it's too soon in their relationship to ask Andrew to go with her to the funeral.

videos.title: E Is for Ectoplasm
videos.overview: Andrew and Zelda decide to drop their usual Halloween traditions and instead throw a joint party.

videos.title: F Is for Fight, Fight, Fight!
videos.overview: After he fails to stand up for Zelda outside a bar, Andrew goes out of his way to try and prove his manliness to Zelda.

videos.title: G Is for Geronimo
videos.overview: Andrew tries to help Zelda go after her big "what if".

videos.title: H Is for Hostile Takeover
videos.overview: When Andrew realises that he is far too influenced by his friends and Zelda, he sets out to find something in his life that is just for him.

videos.title: I Is for Ill Communication
videos.overview: With Christmas approaching, Andrew and Zelda turn to their friends for help to find the perfect Christmas gift for one another.

videos.title: J Is for Jan Vaughan
videos.overview: Zelda and Andrew play matchmakers for Stu and a stenographer, but their love-connection maneuvering negatively impacts Stephie.

videos.title: K Is for Keep Out
videos.overview: Andrew and Zelda seek quality alone time together, which stirs up tension between Andrew and Stu. Meanwhile, Big Bird sets out to win a man's attention.

videos.title: L Is for Likeability
videos.overview: When Andrew’s father Pete unexpectedly shows up to visit, Zelda tries to win his affection after Pete tells Andrew he isn’t a fan of hers. Elsewhere, Big Bird implements a new cancellation policy at Wallflower, despite not having Dane’s corporate approval.

videos.title: M Is for Meant to Be
videos.overview: Tensions flair when Andrew's former flame comes to town.
